resources.string: All the cards are face up. Build four piles from Ace to King, one per suit. On the columns, put each card on one a rank higher of the other color. The four free cells hold one card each. Tap a card to move it, and tap it again to try another place.
Not enough room to move that many cards at once (%1$d): right now the most is %2$d. Empty a free cell or a column first.
Only cards in order, alternating red and black, can move together.
No good move found. Try Undo.
This game can no longer be won from here. You can undo some moves and try another way, or give up.
The cards were blocked: no way to win was left.
